question.prompt:
On the most recent exam in Prof. Xochi’s class,

• \(5\) students earned a score of at least \(95\%,\)

• \(13\) students earned a score of at least \(90\%,\)

• \(27\) students earned a score of at least \(85\%,\) and

• \(50\) students earned a score of at least \(80\%.\)

How many students earned a score of at least \(80\%\) and less than \(90\%?\)

solutions.explanation:
The \(50\) students who scored at least \(80\%\) fall into two separate groups: those scoring less than \(90\%\), and those scoring at least \(90\%\). The second group contains \(13\) students, including anyone who scored exactly \(90\%\). Removing that group leaves exactly the students requested:
\[
50-13=37.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{37}\) students, choice \(\text{D}\).
solutions.title: Remove the higher scores
